headline: SEA @ WSN matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SEA 4.20 at WSN 3.52, with a projected total of 7.72. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward WSN: SEA moved -0.83 runs while WSN moved +0.55, changing the projected margin by -1.38 runs. NRFI probability rose +9.1%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Bryce Miller has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Cole Young, Josh Naylor, CJ Abrams, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Andrés Chaparro, Luke Raley because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
